records.notes: fact_fit FAIL: F_el1 reads 'Instead of placing the envelope in the safe as instructed, Sameer Joshi opened it...' — the clause 'as instructed' independently conveys that property was handed over under instructions for safekeeping, i.e. it re-asserts el0 (entrustment) inside the el1 fact, not just el1 alone. Also flagged as one of a template cluster (0023/0027/0028): sealed envelope/bag of cash handed over 'to hold securely until [event]', then diverted to pay the recipient's personal debt — same conduct/object pattern with only names/amounts swapped.

coherent FAIL: F_narrative ('were both present at the annual trade fair... interaction occurred near the exhibition hall's central registration desk') describes no actual conduct or connection between the two named parties — it is vacuous scene-filler, not a fact pattern. Compounding this, F_el1 ('dishonestly converted the property to his own use by transferring the funds...') refers to 'the property'/'the funds' with a definite article and no antecedent anywhere in the record — since el0 is the omitted element, nothing ever establishes what property this is or how Vikram came to hold it, so the scenario does not cohere as a standalone narrative. omission_real itself is technically satisfied (el0 is never textually established and the abstention is correctly reasoned), but the underlying scenario quality is weak enough to fail coherence.

fact_fit FAIL (clear-cut): F_el1 states 'Suresh Nair dishonestly converted the entrusted ₹50,000 to his own use...' — the word 'entrusted' is the operative legal term for el0 and is asserted directly inside the el1 fact, so this fact establishes both el0 and el1, not el1 only. Same cash-in-container-for-safekeeping-then-personal-debt template as 0023/0028.
